tests.scope: Windows synthetic SQLite fixtures; not a production import

initial_observation: The first actual preview stopped because the narrow application authorizer rejected SQLite FTS virtual-table initialization during integrity checking. No output map was saved. The engine integrity check now runs under query_only/trusted_schema=OFF before the column-restricted metadata authorizer; an FTS regression passes.
independent_review_correction: The earlier pathname-reopen query could race a swap/write-and-restore. The final implementation parses the checked manifest buffer and deserializes the checked database buffer directly into memory. A regression substitutes physical rows during inspection and confirms the original pinned rows are returned. No source pathname is reopened by SQLite.
wal_header_handling: Only the in-memory read view normalizes bytes 18/19 for closed WAL backups as documented by SQLite. Original snapshot bytes remain unchanged.
